messages.subject: R Error in as.POSIXlt.character
parts:
Hi,
I'm trying to convert my data frame in a telemetry object and even if the timestamp is in the correct format I've got this error:
"R Error in as.POSIXlt.character: string not standard unambiguous format".
I'll attach my data frame.
Thanks for any suggestions
Best,
Gianluca

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: R Error in as.POSIXlt.character
parts:
Hi Gianluca

It works if you run the grouped_df object through dplyr::ungroup() first, and I will make that happen automatically in the next update, though that may not always be the intended effect for a "grouped" tbl object.

Best,
Chris
